summary: Iteration 53 — Slangcart perf/UX fixes verification. Backend 17/17 pytest PASSED: /api/admin/products is now paginated (default limit=60, capped 300), slim projection (no base64 anywhere, no images/description/specifications/reviews/questions/interested_users), response size <200KB, ≤ 3 s. /api/products?q= free-text search returns paginated envelope with matches. /api/cart uses batched find + slim projection + no base64 and responds in <500 ms. FRONTEND: /admin/products loads in ~5 s with 5 real products (no 500 error). /admin/shop-layout: switching between Home → Groceries (category) → Groceries › Fruits (subcategory) scope tabs works with NO force-close (verified after seeding a Groceries/Fruits shop_category tree). Shop-category qty stepper: tapping Add turns the button into a -N+ stepper with cart badge updating, increment 1→2 works. **CRITICAL BUG FOUND**: DECREMENT from qty≥2 fails — the FE calls POST /cart/add with qty=-1, but backend models.CartItem enforces qty:int = Field(gt=0), returning HTTP 422. Only qty=1→0 works (uses /cart/remove).

critical.issue: The frontend qty stepper decrement path (shop-category/[name].tsx line 202: `api.post('/cart/add', { product_id: p.id, qty: -1 })`) is rejected with 422 because backend models.CartItem (backend/models.py:294) enforces `qty: int = Field(gt=0)`. Result: decrementing quantity in the stepper works ONLY for qty 1→0 (which uses /cart/remove). Every other decrement (2→1, 3→2, etc.) silently 422s; the FE catch-block rolls the UI back to the previous qty and pops an Alert. The stepper's minus button appears functional in the UI (optimistic update) but does not actually reduce cart quantity.

ui_bugs.issue: Decrement (-) button for cart quantity is broken for qty≥2 due to backend /cart/add gt=0 validator (see backend critical). User taps -, UI briefly drops the number then snaps back with an Alert.

integration_issues.issue: FE decrement uses `POST /cart/add {qty:-1}` expecting Mongo $inc to accept negatives; backend Pydantic CartItem model rejects qty<=0 before ever reaching Mongo. Either loosen the CartItem validator (allow non-zero ints and rely on /cart/remove for qty→0), OR add a dedicated PATCH /cart/{product_id} endpoint and switch the FE call.

action_items: CRITICAL — Fix the qty stepper decrement path. Two options: (a) In /app/backend/models.py:294 relax `qty: int = Field(gt=0)` to allow non-zero (e.g. drop the constraint, let the FE guarantee sign) OR add a new field `delta: int` with no gt-constraint; (b) In /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/shop-category/[name].tsx onDecrement, drop the negative /cart/add call and instead call `/cart/remove` followed by `/cart/add` with the new qty, OR introduce a PATCH /cart/{product_id} endpoint. Option (a) is a one-line fix and keeps the existing UI flow.

rca_of_issue: **Bug: qty stepper decrement broken.** REPRO — log in as testbuyer, set delivery pincode 517644, open /shop-category/General, tap Add on Test Widget (qty=1), tap the + button to go to qty=2, then tap the − button expecting qty=1. Observed: UI briefly shows 1, then snaps back to 2 with an Alert. Backend log/response: HTTP 422 with `Input should be greater than 0 (gt=0)` from Pydantic. CAUSE — /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/shop-category/[name].tsx:202 sends `POST /cart/add {product_id, qty: -1}` for the non-terminal decrement path, but /app/backend/models.py:294 declares `class CartItem: qty: int = Field(gt=0)`. Pydantic rejects the payload before the handler runs so the intended Mongo `$inc: {qty: -1}` never fires. FIX — pick ONE of: (a) relax models.CartItem.qty to allow any int and let the handler decide; (b) introduce PATCH /cart/{product_id} for delta updates; or (c) FE workaround: on decrement, POST /cart/remove then POST /cart/add with next qty. Option (a) is the least invasive.
